description: List the configured Marketo instance's available activity type ids and metadata. Use these authoritative per-instance ids as the mandatory activity_type_ids for get_activities; do not rely on ids copied from another subscription.
embedding_description: Enumerate the configured Marketo subscription's activity type catalog: the numeric activity type ids, names, descriptions, primary attributes and attribute definitions this instance defines. Call it to discover which type ids this particular subscription accepts, since the catalog is per-subscription rather than universal across Marketo.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with records (activity type descriptors carrying id, name, description, primaryAttribute, and attributes) + row_count + spilled=false inline, OR result_blob_key + row_count + spilled=true when large.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Report row_count and the requested activity type ids/names. Point to result_blob_key when the complete catalog spilled.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: When the caller is preparing get_activities, carry only ids returned for this configured instance and keep each request to at most 10 ids.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: List the configured Marketo instance's activity type catalog.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: marketo.auth_failed: OAuth credentials rejected. marketo.permission_denied: the API user's Role lacks Read-Only Activity. marketo.rate_limited: API rate limit exceeded.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: marketo.permission_denied: add Read-Only Activity to the API role, then re-run check_setup. marketo.rate_limited: retry after a short delay.
